headline: Yemeni Government Forces Retreat From Strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait
summary: Forces aligned with Yemen's government announced their redeployment away from districts overlooking the Bab el-Mandeb Strait toward Aden. The withdrawal leaves control over the strategic maritime passage to Houthi forces.
why: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait is a crucial bottleneck for global trade, linking the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden for oil and container shipping.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Loss of government control over Bab el-Mandeb increases potential maritime disruptions for Red Sea oil shipments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Houthi control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait raises risk premiums for international shipping routes and crude oil transport.
